dream: I stood on the wide hay, which felt like a soft drawing I could press through. The Sharp Lip bit my heel but did not slide off into the thin air above. I pressed the Rough Scrap down on a gap that refused to open, feeling the heavy lid of the card hum against my spine like a low tide. The fence leaned wrong, tired and sharp, holding my weight while I forgot why I was standing there at all.
